title: Mindustry: free Factorio alternative
caption:
Factorio costs $35. Mindustry is a factory + tower defense game you can play for free 🏭

✅ Build factories out of conveyor belts and supply chains
✅ Defend your core from waves of enemies
✅ Co-op, PvP and a map editor, cross-platform multiplayer
✅ Two planet campaigns with 250+ tech blocks

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux · Android · iPhone
ℹ️ The Steam version costs $9.99; it's the same game, and the itch.io download is pay-what-you-want, so $0 works. Google Play is free; the App Store version costs $1.99

Comment "FACTORY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
